s.note: Hot baked spinach and artichoke dip with cream cheese and mozzarella.
s.how: Mix 250g softened cream cheese with 100g sour cream, 250g thawed spinach squeezed dry, 1 jar drained chopped artichoke hearts, 1 crushed garlic clove and 100g grated mozzarella. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling and serve with toasted baguette slices.

s.note: Ham and gruyère sandwiches under creamy béchamel, grilled and cut small.
s.how: Make a quick bechamel with 30g butter, a spoon of flour and 250ml milk. Spread bread with Dijon, fill with ham and grated gruyère, and top with bechamel and more cheese. Grill until bubbling and golden, then cut into small squares to share.

m.note: Penne in a rosy tomato, cream and chilli sauce with parmesan, prom night carbs.
m.how: Penne in a rosy sauce of tomato, cream, garlic and chilli, finished with parmesan and basil. Soften 3 crushed garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes in 2 tbsp olive oil. Add a 400g can of crushed tomatoes and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 200ml cream until rosy. Toss with 500g cooked penne, then finish with grated parmesan and torn basil.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into ten squares, one for each thing Kat hates.
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes and cool. Cut into ten squares and top each differently with raspberries, nuts, salt flakes or anything you like.

d.note: Espresso, vanilla and cold milk over ice, sipped to the band at Club Skunk.
d.how: Simmer 80g sugar with 80ml water and a split vanilla bean for 3 minutes and cool. Brew 4 strong espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee, and cool. Shake the coffee with 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and a handful of ice until frothy. Fill four tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the frothy coffee slowly over the top so it sits in layers.
